facts.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges.

business.summary: HDFC Bank is a commercial bank providing banking services, including retail, wholesale, and treasury operations. It generates revenue through interest income, fees, and commissions from its diverse financial products and services, including insurance and other banking operations.

claims.claim: Asset quality remains pristine with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower year-on-year.
claims.quote: Our asset quality remains pristine, with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year-on-year.

claims.claim: Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year, including a 4 percentage point lift from the special FCNR (B) window.
claims.quote: Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year on a reported basis, including a 4 percentage point lift from special FCNR (B) window.

claims.claim: Service delivery turnaround times have decreased by 30% during the quarter.
claims.quote: service delivery TATs have come down by 30% during the quarter.

claims.claim: The bank aims to maintain staff count while shifting more resources to frontline customer-facing roles.
claims.quote: I believe the institution will try to maintain the staff count and try and move more and more people to the frontline.

claims.claim: Cost of funds is the biggest opportunity, but margin improvement will not happen in a hurry.
claims.quote: One is the cost of funds is the biggest opportunity on the margin where compared to our historical norms as well as compared to what we have seen in the industry as such, there can be 40, 50 basis points change, but it is not going to change in a hurry.

claims.claim: Current branch productivity is INR 330 crores per branch, demonstrating strong performance across vintages.
claims.quote: If you look at the per branch metrics, we are about INR 330 crores per branch currently. And if you go back to the FY’23 time period, we were INR 266 crores per branch.

claims.claim: The bank is focusing on increasing unit counts rather than relying on household deposit growth rates.
claims.quote: Our approach is to increase the units to get that benefit. So, this is about the unit economics that we need to drive.

claims.claim: The bank is shifting from an investment phase to harnessing prior technology and distribution investments.
claims.quote: I think, we are probably at the cusp of harnessing these investments, whether it's on the branch distribution or in terms of the technology investments.

claims.claim: Significant technology investments made over the last 5-6 years will provide huge operating leverage in the future.
claims.quote: I would like to remind the sizable investments we made over the last 5 to 6 years, which will bear fruit in the coming years. The above is going to provide a huge operating leverage in the future.

claims.claim: The bank has built a unified in-house AI platform to deploy agents at scale and improve efficiency.
claims.quote: But the big story is how we've created in-house the unified AI platform, which is going to be the center that spans across the entire organization.

claims.claim: The bank is successfully shifting toward more granular and sustainable retail time deposits.
claims.quote: In fact, the less than INR 3 crores deposits have grown, which has been mobilized in 2026 on a net basis, has grown up almost about 74% over the net incremental deposits for FY25.

claims.claim: The bank has successfully increased liability penetration among home loan customers to 50%.
claims.quote: Net of attritions, net of acquisitions over this journey, this 36% has come as high as 50% within the last 2.5 years.

risks.text: Bank is party to various taxation matters and legal proceedings in normal course of business.
Material modification in related party transaction with HDFC Life requires member approval.
Identification and provisioning of non-performing advances involve management estimates and complex system logics.
High reliance on complex IT systems and automated controls for financial reporting processes.
